{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with -999 in biomarker_baseline
filtered_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending), then drop duplicates
deduplicated_data = filtered_data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
deduplicated_data = deduplicated_data.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the final number of patients
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication and filtering: {len(deduplicated_data)}")

# Check the distribution of arms and severity
print("\nArm distribution:")
print(deduplicated_data['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(deduplicated_data['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if arms and severity are confounded
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(deduplicated_data['arm'], deduplicated_data['severity']))"}
